Subject: Quote: LED accent track + modular counter shelving (CloudCon booth)

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks for the call this morning — attached is our firm quote for the LED accent track lighting (dimmable, 3000K) and the modular counter shelving with acrylic risers you requested for Redwood's island kiosk at CloudCon. Key details:

- Lighting: 4x low-profile LED tracks, 45W each, DMX-compatible dimmer, power tap to booth power at 20A. Lead time: 7 business days. Rental price (3 days): $1,250.
- Shelving: 2 modular counter units (48" x 24"), 3-tier acrylic risers, black powder coat. One spare shelf kit included. Lead time: 10 business days. Rental price (3 days): $980.
- On-site tech support: $450/day (recommended for setup/strike).
- Freight & labor (to Moscone West loading dock): estimated $320.

Total estimated (rental + tech + freight): $3,000 (excl. tax). Quote number: SL-20261104-897. Attached: ShowLoop_quote_20261104.pdf and shelving-specs-v2.pdf.

We can hold pricing through 2026-11-12 but can expedite delivery for an additional 15% rush fee.

Next steps: 1) confirm acceptance or request PO, 2) confirm booth power tap location with exhibit operations team, 3) advise whether Redwood will provide local AV extension cords.

Let me know if you'd like us to send a mechanical layout mock with the fixture callouts.

Best,
